items.title: 【招聘】区块链后端工程师｜Go / EVM / Solana / DEX / Meme｜$6,000–8,000/月
items.description:
岗位职责:
• 负责平台链上交易核心模块后端研发，包含 Meme 币、多链代币、合约、预测市场等交易链路开发与迭代，对接 DEX、链上 RPC，完成链上签名、发单、交易上链、交易回执解析等功能。
• 搭建链上行情与 Meme 生态数据采集、清洗、聚合、存储、分发系统；开发链上 Token 监控、新币扫描、链上大户钱包追踪、热度指标等数据服务，支撑 AI 智能推荐能力落地。
• 负责后端平台服务开发，保障生产环境高可用、高并发、低延迟；设计业务解耦方案，妥善管理复杂交易状态，做好服务监控、故障排查与性能优化。
• 主导研发工程效能建设，落地 CI/CD 持续集成、自动化测试、灰度发布、线上运维等流程，提升团队交付效率。
• 深度参与 Meme 赛道业务需求评审、技术方案设计，理解 Meme 币交易场景、热点周期、用户行为特征，和产品、前端、AI 团队协同迭代交易终端产品。
• 跟进区块链生态、Meme 赛道前沿技术与市场动态，输出技术调研方案，持续优化产品架构。

岗位要求:
• 本科及以上学历，计算机相关专业。
• 扎实计算机基础，精通常用数据结构、算法、网络、操作系统原理。
• 熟练使用 #Go 语言开发，具备异步、并发编程实战经验。
• 熟练使用 MySQL、Redis，熟悉 Kafka 等消息队列，具备分布式系统开发经验。
• 精通高并发系统设计，擅长业务解耦、分布式事务、复杂状态管理。
• 了解区块链基础原理，熟悉 EVM/Solana 等至少一条公链，有链上交互、DEX 对接、Meme 币相关后端开发项目经验。
• 熟悉 Meme 赛道生态，了解 Meme 币的市场玩法、热点逻辑、链上数据指标，有 Meme 工具、链上扫描器、交易机器人开发经验优先。
• 对 Web3、AI 交易赛道抱有强烈好奇心，具备主动学习能力、自驱力与主人翁意识。
• 必须完全掌握 AI 辅助研发与 AI Agent 工具，能够独立应用于后端需求分析、技术方案设计、Go 编码、调试、单元/集成测试、性能优化、代码审查和技术文档编写。
• 熟练掌握任务拆解、指令设计、上下文管理、代码库检索、终端与工具调用、长任务执行和 Agent 工作流编排。


📮 联系方式: Email: support@aerrecens.com

items.title: [Remote & SG] Ekvahlabs 正在招聘区块链开发人员
items.description:
# 🚀 Blockchain Developer

**Company:** EkvahLabs
**Location:** Ontario, Canada
**Timezone:** Flexible / Remote-friendly
**Website:** [[EkvahLabs](https://ekvahlabs.com/)](https://ekvahlabs.com)

## 🔗 Role Overview

EkvahLabs is looking for an experienced **Blockchain Developer** to join our engineering team and help build and maintain blockchain-based applications, Web3 products, and infrastructure.

The role focuses on developing decentralized features, blockchain integrations, smart contracts, wallet systems, transaction flows, and supporting backend infrastructure.

You’ll work with technologies such as:

* **Solidity**
* **TypeScript**
* **Node.js**
* **Ethers.js / Web3 libraries**
* **Smart Contracts**
* Blockchain APIs and infrastructure
* Wallet integrations
* NFT and Web3 technologies

## 🛠️ Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain blockchain-based applications and services
* Design, develop, test, and deploy **Solidity smart contracts**
* Build blockchain APIs and Web3 integrations
* Implement wallet connections and transaction flows
* Integrate blockchain functionality with frontend and backend systems
* Work with blockchain infrastructure and RPC providers
* Develop and maintain secure and reliable on-chain/off-chain systems
* Troubleshoot and debug complex blockchain-related issues
* Participate in technical architecture and engineering decisions
* Conduct code reviews and maintain high-quality development standards
* Improve application security, scalability, reliability, and performance
* Write automated tests for smart contracts and blockchain functionality
* Collaborate with frontend engineers, backend engineers, product teams, and other technical stakeholders

## 💡 Required Skills & Experience

* Strong professional experience in **blockchain / Web3 development**
* Strong knowledge of **Solidity and smart contract development**
* Strong **TypeScript / Node.js** experience
* Experience with **Ethers.js, Web3.js, or similar Web3 libraries**
* Experience with blockchain wallets and transaction systems
* Understanding of EVM-based blockchain networks
* Experience integrating blockchain systems with APIs and backend services
* Strong understanding of blockchain security and common smart contract vulnerabilities
* Experience with Git and modern software development workflows
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills

## ⭐ Nice to Have

The following experience would be highly valuable:

* **Full-stack development experience, preferably 7+ years**
* Professional experience working with **cryptocurrency exchanges**
* Experience building or maintaining exchange-related systems, trading infrastructure, wallets, deposits/withdrawals, or transaction processing
* **Deep understanding of NFTs**, including NFT standards, marketplaces, minting, metadata, ownership, transfers, and smart contract architecture
* Experience with NFT marketplaces or NFT-based applications
* Experience with DeFi protocols and decentralized applications
* Experience with cryptocurrency payment systems
* Experience with blockchain gaming or Web3 gaming platforms
* Experience working with multiple EVM-compatible networks
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and production deployments

## 🌎 Location & Timezone

**Location:** Ontario, Canada

We are open to candidates working remotely from different locations.

**Timezone:** Flexible.

Candidates do not need to be located in the same timezone, although reasonable availability for collaboration with the engineering team is expected.

## 💰 Compensation

**9,000–12,000/month**, depending on experience, technical expertise, and overall fit.

There is flexibility for exceptional candidates with significant blockchain, exchange, NFT, or full-stack experience.

## 📩 How to Apply

If you’re interested in exploring the opportunity, please provide your latest **CV or portfolio**, particularly highlighting:

* Blockchain / Web3 projects
* Solidity and smart contract experience
* Cryptocurrency exchange experience
* NFT-related projects
* Full-stack development experience
* GitHub repositories
* Wallet and transaction integrations
* Relevant production experience

After reviewing your background, we’ll follow up with the next steps.

========================================================================================

# 🚀 区块链开发工程师（Blockchain Developer）

**公司：** EkvahLabs
**工作地点：** 加拿大安大略省（Ontario, Canada）
**时区：** 灵活 / 支持远程工作
**官方网站：** [[EkvahLabs](https://ekvahlabs.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)](https://ekvahlabs.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 🔗 职位概述

EkvahLabs 正在寻找一名经验丰富的 **区块链开发工程师（Blockchain Developer）** 加入我们的工程团队，参与区块链应用、Web3 产品以及相关基础设施的开发与维护。

该职位主要负责去中心化功能、区块链集成、智能合约、钱包系统、链上交易流程以及相关后端基础设施的设计与开发。

你将接触并使用以下技术：

* **Solidity**
* **TypeScript**
* **Node.js**
* **Ethers.js / Web3 Libraries**
* **智能合约（Smart Contracts）**
* 区块链 API 与基础设施
* 钱包集成
* NFT 与 Web3 技术

## 🛠️ 工作职责

* 开发和维护基于区块链的应用程序及服务
* 设计、开发、测试并部署 **Solidity 智能合约**
* 构建区块链 API 以及 Web3 集成功能
* 实现钱包连接及链上交易流程
* 将区块链功能与前端、后端系统进行集成
* 使用并维护区块链基础设施及 RPC 服务
* 开发和维护安全、稳定可靠的链上 / 链下系统
* 排查和解决复杂的区块链技术问题
* 参与技术架构设计及工程技术决策
* 进行代码审查（Code Review），并持续维护高质量代码标准
* 持续提升系统的安全性、可扩展性、稳定性和性能
* 编写智能合约及区块链相关功能的自动化测试
* 与前端工程师、后端工程师、产品团队及其他技术团队成员密切协作

## 💡 任职要求

* 具备较强的 **区块链 / Web3 开发** 实际项目经验
* 深入掌握 **Solidity 及智能合约开发**
* 具备扎实的 **TypeScript / Node.js** 开发经验
* 熟悉 **Ethers.js、Web3.js 或其他类似 Web3 开发库**
* 具备区块链钱包及链上交易系统开发经验
* 理解基于 **EVM（Ethereum Virtual Machine）** 的区块链网络
* 具备区块链系统与 API、后端服务进行集成的经验
* 对区块链安全以及常见智能合约漏洞有深入理解
* 熟悉 Git 以及现代软件开发流程
* 具备较强的调试、问题分析和解决能力

## ⭐ 加分项（Nice to Have）

以下经验将作为重要加分项：

* **7 年以上全栈开发经验（Full-Stack Development）**
* 具有 **加密货币交易所（Cryptocurrency Exchange）** 相关工作经验
* 具有交易所系统、交易基础设施、钱包、充值 / 提现或交易处理系统的开发及维护经验
* **深入理解 NFT 技术及生态**，包括 NFT 标准、NFT Marketplace、Mint、Metadata、资产所有权、Transfer 以及智能合约架构等
* 具有 NFT Marketplace 或 NFT 应用开发经验
* 具有 DeFi 协议及去中心化应用（DApp）开发经验
* 具有加密货币支付系统开发经验
* 具有区块链游戏或 Web3 游戏平台开发经验
* 具有多个 EVM 兼容区块链网络的开发经验
* 具有云基础设施、CI/CD 以及生产环境部署经验

## 🌎 工作地点与时区

**工作地点：** 加拿大安大略省（Ontario, Canada）

我们支持远程工作，并欢迎来自不同地区的优秀候选人。

**时区：** 灵活。

候选人无需与团队处于相同的时区，但需要能够在合理的工作时间内与工程团队进行沟通和协作。

## 💰 薪资待遇

**9,000–12,000 / 月**

具体薪资将根据候选人的工作经验、技术能力以及整体匹配程度确定。

对于在区块链、加密货币交易所、NFT 或全栈开发领域拥有丰富经验的优秀候选人，我们可以提供更具竞争力的薪资待遇。

## 📩 如何申请

如果你对这个职位感兴趣，请提供最新的 **CV / 简历或个人作品集（Portfolio）**，并重点介绍以下相关经验：

* 区块链 / Web3 项目
* Solidity 及智能合约开发经验
* 加密货币交易所相关经验
* NFT 相关项目
* 全栈开发经验
* GitHub 开源项目或代码仓库
* 钱包及链上交易集成经验
* 相关生产环境项目经验

我们审核你的资料后，将与你进一步沟通后续流程。

### 🌐 关于 EkvahLabs

欢迎访问我们的官方网站，进一步了解 EkvahLabs 及我们的项目：

[[ekvahlabs.com](https://ekvahlabs.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)](https://ekvahlabs.com?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

## 📬 联系方式

如果你有兴趣加入我们，可以在下方评论，或者通过以下方式联系我们，并发送你的 **CV / Portfolio**：

**Email：**

* [[hello@ekvahlabs.com](mailto:hello@ekvahlabs.com)](mailto:hello@ekvahlabs.com)
* [[ceo@ekvahlabs.com](mailto:ceo@ekvahlabs.com)](mailto:ceo@ekvahlabs.com)

**Telegram：**

* @harunofurukawa

**期待与你交流！** 🚀

items.title: Add an "Updated At" timestamp column so readers can spot new roles
items.description:
The `Date Posted` column is day-level only, so when new roles get added between refreshes there's no way to tell which rows are new since my last visit — I have to re-scan the whole table from the top and remember where I left off.

Proposal: add a column (e.g. `Updated At`) showing the date + time each row was added or updated by the bot, like:

| Company | Job Title | Location | Date Posted | Updated At |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Company A | ... | ... | Sep 29 | Sep 29, 13:53 |
| Company B | ... | ... | Sep 29 | Sep 29, 17:54 |

This should be feasible since the bot already knows when it inserts each row (the timestamp is implicit in the commit history today) — persisting it per-row just makes it visible to everyone. Readers could then instantly see what's new since their last refresh.

You will work inside the client's Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environment and collaborate daily with the client's US-based teams on systems that store, process or transmit protected health information (PHI).

The Security Engineer is the primary architect and engineer of preventive and detective security controls across the client's endpoint, identity, network, cloud and application layers. You will lead the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the security control environment, run vulnerability management, and build the technical evidence that keeps the client audit-ready.

## Key Responsibilities

### Security Architecture & Engineering

- Design, deploy and manage core security platforms: EDR, email security, identity protection, privileged access management, network security and data loss prevention.
- Advance zero trust across identity, device, network and application layers, strengthening conditional access, MFA and least privilege.
- Improve Azure and Microsoft 365 security posture through configuration baselines, policy as code and continuous posture management.
- Set security standards, hardening baselines and reference architectures; run security design reviews for new systems, integrations, vendors and changes.

### Vulnerability & Threat Management

- Lead the vulnerability management program: scanning coverage, risk-based prioritisation, remediation tracking and exception governance.
- Align patching, configuration and end-of-life remediation with security priorities and clinical uptime requirements.
- Direct penetration tests, red team engagements and attack surface management, and validate remediation.
- Use threat intelligence and healthcare-sector attack trends to refine control priorities.

### Compliance Engineering & Detection Enablement

- Build technical controls and evidence supporting HIPAA Security Rule, HITRUST, SOC 2 and client security requirements.
- Strengthen SOC detection by engineering log sources, telemetry pipelines and automated response integrations.
- Define measures for control coverage, vulnerability remediation and platform health; report control gaps, risk posture and investment priorities to leadership.
- Manage security vendors, MSPs and consultants.

### Education & Certifications

- Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field; an equivalent combination of education, certifications and experience will be considered.
- **CISSP, CCSP** or equivalent advanced security certification required; Microsoft SC-100 or AZ-500 preferred.

### Experience

- 7+ years of information security experience, including at least 3 years in security engineering or architecture.
- Experience designing and operating enterprise security platforms across endpoint, identity, email, network and cloud.
- Proven success measurably reducing risk, e.g. remediation rates, MFA and EDR coverage, or reduced privileged access.
- Experience supporting HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2 or ISO 27001 assessments with technical evidence and remediation.
- Healthcare, healthcare technology or managed services experience is a strong advantage.

### Knowledge & Skills

- Security controls in Azure, Microsoft 365 and hybrid Active Directory environments.
- NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, CIS Controls and zero trust principles.
- IAM, PKI, network segmentation, encryption and secure configuration management.
- EDR, SIEM, SOAR, PAM, DLP, email security, vulnerability scanning and CSPM platforms.
- PowerShell, Python and infrastructure as code for automation and evidence collection.
- HIPAA Security Rule and HITRUST CSF control mapping (training provided).
- Professional English (spoken and written) for daily work with US-based colleagues and clients.

### Personal Abilities

- Design controls that reduce risk without impeding clinical workflows.
- Translate emerging threats into practical control improvements and lead implementations through to handoff.
- Present risk and architecture decisions clearly in English to executive and clinical leadership.

## Working Conditions

- Flexible working hours, with an agreed daily overlap window with US-based teams for meetings and real-time collaboration; participation in a shared on-call escalation rotation for security incidents.
- A dedicated, private workspace with stable high-speed internet suitable for handling confidential information and PHI.
- Fully remote from Vietnam.
- Prolonged computer use and extended phone and video communication; sustained concentration during incidents, maintenance windows and time-sensitive work.

## What We Offer

- 💰 Salary reviewed annually.
- 🏠 Flexible working hours and fully remote work.
- 🎁 13th-month salary and performance bonus.
- 🌙 Night-shift allowance in accordance with the Vietnam Labour Code for any additional hours worked at night.
- 🏥 Full social, health and unemployment insurance in accordance with Vietnamese law, plus private healthcare insurance.
- 📚 Company-sponsored certifications and training budget.
- 💻 Company-managed laptop and equipment.
- 🌴 Annual leave of at least 12 days plus Vietnamese public holidays.
- 🌍 Long-term work with international teams on US healthcare technology.
